name: Punta Cana International Airport

handling.v: private aircraft use the Executive Terminal (FBO), operated by Grupo Puntacana; e-ticket form 24 hours ahead

notes: Read: Grupo Puntacana airport site 'Private Aviation' page (states 'Punta Cana International Airport (PUJ)', runways 09/27 and 08/26, IFR/VFR; no lengths, hours or customs) and its airport fact sheet PDF (undated, pre-2017; ramp 14 positions; no runway data). IDAC Dominican Republic AIP not found online. Runway lengths, hours, customs not available from an official open source.
